Indian Seafarers Safe After Tanker Attack in Strait of Hormuz

Six Indian seafarers were aboard a Liberia-flagged tanker that was attacked in the Persian Gulf, specifically in the Strait of Hormuz. Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal confirmed that three of the Indian seafarers are safe following the incident. The tanker was Saudi-flagged.
